text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since Mejiro
McQueen's remarkable victory
at the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our little team of one has grown at last.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
From the very first moment I saw your
elegance in motion, I knew that
I just HAD
to join!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Your victory... So stunning... I was, sniff... so mooooved!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-I'm flattered.

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to give it my all and chase my
dreams just like you did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: B-by all means... Please do just that!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Seems like they were all drawn in by your
performance, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I know... but it's all a touch embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... How was that time?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Six furlongs in a neat eighty seconds. No
complaints here!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Six furlongs in a neat eighty seconds. No
complaints here!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! So this is what it means to be a
Tenno Sho champion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness! W-won't you please give
me some space?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though, I must admit, I'm happy to train
alongside a lively Team
Sirius again.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We owe it all to your victory at the spring
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We owe it all to your victory at the spring
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think that my own running would have
such an influence on the
team...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, we aren't in the clear yet. Let's keep
pushing forward, as a team!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, can you teach me about good
running form?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, I wouldn't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! How can I leave the gate as
deftly as you do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let me show you that right now.

McQueen, my tummy hungy. Won't you
treat me to some carrot cake?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that would be no problem at—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, who said that?! I didn't mean that
just now!
Duh, it's me. Yo, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: G-Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Acquaintance" would be... saying a bit
much. She's more like a pest
who won't
leave me be.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, I watched the Tenno Sho! You were
as cool as ever!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Especially that part when ya used your
own body as a shield to
protect your allies
from enemy fire!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Nothing of the sort ever happened! What
kind of firing is happening
during a
footrace?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You don't gotta explain anything. We
know what we saw! The running
part
practically had me in tears!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I came out here. Figured
you might be doing some
more stunt
practice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if you simply watch, just...
Please don't get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay! I'll just zip it and watch, don't
worry!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, my good fellows, shift your attention
toward Irongut McQueen,
as she
enlightens us on how to down a furlong's
length of wasabi rolls!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, for the love of—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew... Today was quite exhausting...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho really did a number on
your leggies, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: For goodness' sake, you have done a number on my patience. That's all.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship has a point. You did just finish a
big race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And I must start preparing for the next.
There's no time to waste.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My ambitions do not simply end with the
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? One lifelong dream right on to the
next, eh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! As a member of the prestigious
Mejiro family, I cannot
fathom settling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I also have a whole team of racers
to support.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Tryhard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm trying my hardest! This is
certainly no time to be fooling
around!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good to know. And glad you'll be
keepin' those legs on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've decided! You've got another
new team member starting
now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's efforts have caught the eyes of
many far and wide. And
thanks to that...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woo! Congrats! Not sure what you're
talkin' about, but awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The team may not be disbanded, but I'm
still worried nonetheless...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she has a point in that the team was assembled haphazardly, I genuinely believe that it will be home to true stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she has a point in that the team was assembled haphazardly, I genuinely believe that it will be home to true stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because Sirius has Mejiro McQueen as its
guiding light.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahoy mateys! Weigh anchor and set sail,
Team McQueen!
